spec.text: Image 1 is the man's model sheet, image 2 the woman's model sheet, image 3 a real photo of the Taipei Guest House, image 4 the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Recreate the ornate white Western-style mansion from image 3 at night, softly lit, behind a black iron fence with a tree-lined sidewalk in front, in the warm matte clay and gouache storybook style of image 4, deep blue night sky, warm street lamps. The SAME couple in their casual outfits walk side by side along the sidewalk in side view, their inner hands just about to touch, full bodies about four heads tall. Cinematic 16:9. No readable text, no extra people, no photorealism. The couple must be rendered as dimensional sculpted matte clay figurines exactly like the people in image 4, with soft volume, subsurface warmth and contact shadows, never as flat 2D drawings. Any shop signs or plaques are blank.
